title: Haute Couture Meets Entomology Fashion Art
summary: Conceptual art piece: insect anatomy reconstructed entirely from luxury fashion house textiles — exoskeleton formed from Hermès, Chanel, Versace, and Dior fabrics. Four insects, four brands, one image.
prompt: <instructions> Input = Luxury Fashion House. Identify 4 iconic fashion brands and their signature fabrics/patterns. Function Draw ($Fashion_Brand, $ Insect_Species) ... Anchor: [$Insect_Species] :: [$Fashion_Brand]::4 | Morphology: Biological anatomy of [$Insect_Species] reconstructed via the assemblage of [$Fashion_Brand] textiles, exoskeleton formed from constituent haute couture garments, wings from signature prints, legs from accessory leather, eyes from jewellery stones. Generate 4 insects, each anchored to one brand. Render as high-end editorial studio photography on white background. </instructions>
